data.narrative:
Profluent, a Series B biotech company founded by Ali Madani, is evaluated against a comp universe of 3 public equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the company's $150M total raised, yielding an implied valuation of $285M. Peer-median analysis across four same-sector comparables—Eikon Therapeutics at $539M (Series B), Chai Discovery at $3.8B (Series C), New Limit at $3.1B (Series C), and Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B (Series C)—produces a median of $3.5B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue data, though the sector median P/S is 5.6x across the three public tickers.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a valuation range of $242M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.9B. This wide dispersion reflects the substantial stage and maturity heterogeneity within the peer set, particularly the presence of three Series C comparables commanding significantly higher valuations. Key uncertainties include Profluent's underlying revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and the applicability of later-stage Series C valuations to a Series B position.
